entities.name: Alberto Merlati
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alberto Merlati was an Italian basketball player. He won among others the silver medal at the 1967 Mediterranean Games and won the Lega Basket Serie A. Merlati died on 12 December 2024, at the age of 81.
